for_sales.sales_text:
The price is nil if a prospective owner has a permanent mooring and is able to take her from her present berth.
The rig and sails are stored as at present she is used as a motor boat on the Norfolk Broads. Out of the water every three years for re-painting etc. her Iroko hull(oak garboards) appear in perfect condition even allowing for her 26 years.

Due to changed circumstances this beautiful craft is looking for a new owner to live aboard or cruise her in the manner for which she was designed. If you are interested in owning her, can moor and maintain her please contact me to view her where she is being used, on the Norfolk Broads.

boat.full_description: Gaff cutter with tan main and stay sails, and a cream foresail.
boat.name: Frances Mary
